newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Implats, Lonrho merger dead - Gencor.
newsitem.headline: Implats, Lonrho merger dead - Gencor.

text.p: Gencor Ltd executive chairman Brian Gilbertson said on Monday that the planned merger between its Impala Platinum Holdings Ltd and the platinum interests of Lonrho Plc was no longer in prospect.
"From a Gencor point of view, we are taking the position that it is not on and we will continue to run Impala in its own way without that improvement we hoped for," Gilbertson told reporters.
The European Commission's decision earlier this year to block the proposed merger had been a great disappointment, Gilbertson said.
"Although Impala is appealing this decision in the European Court, I fear that the opportunity to create substantial shareholder value in a short space of time has been lost for both parties."
Lonrho has already said it will not back the appeal in the European Court.
The merged company would have held 28 percent of the world's platinum market, with Anglo American Platinum Corp Ltd holding 35 percent.
